updates.title: VAICOM Community Edition for DCS World
updates.releasenotes:
Release 3.1.4.3

New
- OpenKneeboard FLT PLN Out added, with DTC/route import, NAVLOG pages, route maps, overlays, timing tools, and post-flight summaries.
- New F-4E WSO/Jester 2.0 commands for radar target focus/lock and fuel/tanker workflows.
- AI Crew Page support added to OpenKneeboard and recipient aliases.
- Custom F-4E Jester mods added, including Shutdown and Radar Altitude Monitor.

Improved
- OpenKneeboard output now supports better browsing, richer layouts, grouped keyword views, night mode, and configurable output port.
- WSO/Jester dialog caching and command routing are more robust.
- Runtime kneeboard data capture now includes more mission, route, radio, and friendly asset information.

Fixed
- Fixed several hot mic / AIRIO / AI Crew command handling issues.
- Fixed F-14 AIRIO/Jester related setup behaviour.
- Fixed F-4E WSO seat-state detection and related routing behaviour.
- Fixed delayed transmit/PTT send timing issues.
- Fixed several WSO dialog, cache, and target/tuning resolution issues.
